summary: Iteration 3 frontend regression of SignuluOne static site focused on the 4 new industry pages (manufacturing, healthcare, legal-services, information-technology) plus the 3 existing (banking-and-financial-services, real-estate, professional-services). Verified section testids, trial/demo buttons and their hrefs, theme tokens (nav 76px, Lato, section 80/80, footer bg rgb(44,47,54), .btn-accent bg rgb(90,48,241)), industries mega-menu, home industry tiles, /industries.html grid, footer industries column, responsive at 375/768/1440, and regressions on pricing (tabs + Monthly/Yearly toggle $9.99<->$59.88 + BulkSigner licence estimator). All acceptance criteria pass; no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Every industry page duplicates ~200 lines of near-identical scaffolding. Consider extracting the hero/intro/benefits/usecases/summary/cta into a partial + JSON data file to keep the seven pages truly identical structurally and reduce maintenance cost.

pricing.html billing toggle target is the inner checkbox #billingToggle; the data-testid 'esign-billing-toggle' is on a wrapper div, so automated tests that click the wrapper won't fire the change event. Consider moving data-testid onto the <input> or adding a redundant one for clarity.
Trial/demo buttons on industry pages hard-code product=esignature. If a page ever needs to funnel to DMS or BulkSigner, that will require per-page overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 industry pages share the same structural testids: <slug>-hero,-intro,-benefits,-usecases,-summary,-cta,-trial-btn,-demo-btn,-cta-trial-btn,-cta-demo-btn,-breadcrumb-link. Mega-menu, home tiles, footer, /industries.html all cross-linked correctly. Pricing tests: use '#billingToggle' (checkbox) not the wrapper div; estimator input is [data-testid=bulk-licence-input], results at [data-testid=bulk-estimate-plan/total/rate]. Base URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
